objective: Investigate and fix a bug where the chat for both assistants and agents stops working after some time, CPU spikes, and the app locks up.

branch_policy.notes: Per CLAUDE.md, fix on the 1.9.x line; never use v2.

primary_hypothesis.summary: Leaked / self-multiplying requestAnimationFrame loop in useSmoothStream, driven by an unstable inline onUpdate callback in Markdown.tsx. Orphaned rAF loops accumulate and busy-spin, saturating CPU and freezing the UI.
primary_hypothesis.isolation: Only self-rescheduling rAF loop in the renderer; all other rAF call sites are one-shot.

secondary_candidates: Markdown.tsx effect feedback churn (driver of the primary bug)
message list / virtualization effects (Messages.tsx, AgentSessionMessages.tsx) — amplifiers to rule out
nextRecommendedAction: Execute fix-001-smoothstream-raf-leak (TDD): single-loop refactor of useSmoothStream + stabilize Markdown.tsx onUpdate + regression test. Then fix-002 verification. Do not use v2.
